stepBody: Suppose our first $$6$$ singular values are $$56$$, $$53$$, $$21$$, $$20$$, $$20$$, $$19$$. What fraction of the variance is captured by the first two principal components? Do not carry out any arithmetic operations; just give us a numerical expression that could be evaluated into the correct answer. Regardless of your answer to the previous problem, you may assume that you know $$\mathcal{V}, $$ and may give your answer for this problem in terms of $$\mathcal{V}.$$ If there is not enough information, write "not enough information."
